title: Rust search
body: Rust makes systems programming productive and reliable.

title: Ranking with BM25
body: BM25 ranks documents using term frequency and document frequency.

title: Query processing
body: A search query can contain an exact phrase.

title: Web Crawling
body: A web crawler visits webpages, extracts useful content, and follows links to discover additional pages.

title: Inverted Index
body: An inverted index maps terms to the documents in which those terms appear.

title: Text Tokenization
body: Tokenization breaks text into individual words or tokens that can be processed by a search engine.

title: Search Ranking
body: Search ranking determines the order in which documents are presented based on their relevance to a query.

title: TF-IDF
body: TF-IDF measures how important a term is to a document relative to the collection of documents.

title: Search Engine
body: A search engine retrieves and ranks relevant documents in response to a user's search query.

title: Word Stemming
body: Stemming reduces related words to a common root form to improve search matching.

title: Phrase Search
body: Phrase search finds documents containing multiple words in a specific order as an exact phrase.

title: Document Indexing
body: Indexing processes documents and stores information that allows search queries to be answered efficiently.

title: Search Relevance
body: Search relevanument matches the intent and terms of a user's query.
